Package org.apache.juneau.http.classic.response

Class BasicHttpResponse<SELF extends BasicHttpResponse<SELF>>

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.http.classic.response.BasicHttpResponse<SELF>
Type Parameters:
SELF - The self type for fluent setters.
All Implemented Interfaces:
HttpMessage, HttpResponse
Direct Known Subclasses:
Accepted, AlreadyReported, Continue, Created, EarlyHints, Found, IMUsed, MovedPermanently, MultipleChoices, MultiStatus, NoContent, NonAuthoritiveInformation, NotModified, Ok, PartialContent, PermanentRedirect, Processing, ResetContent, SeeOther, SwitchingProtocols, TemporaryRedirect, UseProxy
@Marshalled(as=STRING) public abstract class BasicHttpResponse<SELF extends BasicHttpResponse<SELF>> extends Object implements HttpResponse
Basic implementation of the HttpResponse interface.

Although this class implements the various setters defined on the HttpResponse interface, it's in general going to be more efficient to set the status/headers/content of this bean through the builder.

Immutability is expressed with the "funnel + nested Unmodifiable snapshot" paradigm: every mutator (fluent setter and void interface mutator) routes through the single protected modify(Runnable) choke-point, and each concrete leaf gets a nested X.Unmodifiable whose only behavioral override is a throwing modify(...). A leaf's unmodifiable() factory returns a point-in-time snapshot of type X.Unmodifiable; any attempt to set a property on it throws an UnsupportedOperationException.

This is a self-typed (CRTP) root: a leaf declares class Ok extends BasicHttpResponse<Ok> and inherits leaf-typed fluent setters with no covariant overrides.

Notes:
  • Beans are not thread safe unless they're marked as unmodifiable.

    • unmodifiable

      public abstract SELF unmodifiable()
      Returns an unmodifiable snapshot of this bean.

      The returned instance is a point-in-time copy of the leaf's nested Unmodifiable type; any attempt to set a property on it throws an UnsupportedOperationException. This method is idempotent: if this bean is already unmodifiable it returns itself rather than taking another snapshot. The receiver is left unchanged (and still modifiable unless it was already unmodifiable).

      Returns:
      An unmodifiable snapshot of this bean, or this bean if it is already unmodifiable.

    • modify

      protected SELF modify(Runnable mutation)
      Single mutation funnel — the only choke-point through which all state changes on this bean flow.

      Every mutator (fluent setter and void interface mutator) routes through this method. The nested Unmodifiable snapshot overrides only this method to throw, which freezes the entire mutation surface with a single override.

      Parameters:
      mutation - The state change to apply.
      Returns:
      This object.

    • freeze

      protected void freeze()
      Deep-freeze hook invoked from the nested Unmodifiable constructor after the snapshot copy completes.

      The mutable sub-beans are frozen here by direct field assignment (never via a setter, which would route through the throwing modify(Runnable) and blow up during construction). A leaf that adds its own mutable sub-bean overrides this method (calling super.freeze() first).
